What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI says:

Here’s a quick rundown of how returns and refunds work with us:

Rentals arriving late: If your item arrives after the first rental day, you’re generally eligible for a full refund if you report the issue on the first day, then return it within 24 hours of delivery. If you keep it longer, you may only receive a partial refund and could be charged late fees if you go past your original rental period.
Doesn’t fit: Refunds for fit depend on the lender’s own policy. If they offer fit refunds, these are issued as app credit only (no expiry, but not convertible to cash). Delivery and cleaning fees are non‑refundable.
Item in poor or misrepresented condition: Take photos and message the lender the day it arrives, then post it back within 24 hours if you can’t use it. You can then request a refund in‑app from the Rental page. If the lender doesn’t respond to your in‑app refund request within 72 hours, you’re advised to email our support team so we can step in.
How to request a refund: During your inspection window (until 23:59 on day 1 of the rental), report an issue on the Rental page and choose Request Refund, then enter the amount. Approved refunds for these cases are usually sent back to your original payment method within about 8 working days, rental cost only (service fees are non‑refundable).
Quality & return condition: You must return items on time (posted back on the last day of your rental with next‑day, tracked postage) and in the same condition you received them—no new damage, stains, or alterations. If an item is returned damaged or needing specialist cleaning, lenders can send you a charge request for repairs/cleaning.
Sales (buying items): If you buy an item rather than rent it, all sales are final and no refunds are available once the purchase is confirmed.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

You say:
What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

We don’t have a traditional “warranty” like a retail store, but we do protect you if a rental arrives defective or not as described.

If your item arrives in poor condition:

Within 24 hours of delivery/start date:
Document clear photos and report the issue in the app during your inspection window (by 23:59 on day 1).
Message the lender immediately and, if unusable, return the item within 24 hours.
From the Rental page, select Request Refund, enter the amount, and submit. Approved refunds cover the rental cost only (platform service fees are non‑refundable) and are paid back within about 8 working days.

If you miss the inspection window:

Automated refunds aren’t available.
You can still message the lender to see if they’ll agree to a partial or full refund; if you both agree, they can be processed manually.

If the lender doesn’t respond to your refund request within 72 hours, you can email our team with your rental reference, reason, and photos so we can step in and help resolve it.
